physical_scope: Independent fixed-volume closed compartments with reversible detailed-balance mass action, finite conserved moieties and charge; synthetic two-site calcium buffering example
checks: Strict named species, compartments, reactions, complete controls, material stoichiometry and charge; no independent inconsistent reverse constants
Independent scalar polynomial DOP853 and Radau references with material, extent and dissipation trajectories
Timestep refinement including off-grid observations; analytic one-site binding equilibrium and multimerization with a conserved catalyst
Per-compartment material, charge, reaction-ledger and free-energy balance; positive amounts at every RK4 trial and complete cubic observation domain
Blocked reactions, zero rates, no reactions, piecewise release, independent compartment ownership, renamed species and changed padding
Exact complete checkpoint restart, terminal continuation, future control branches, changed windows and world partitions 1/2/3 with nonzero IDs
Actual float64 CPU and L4 states, CPU/GPU correspondence, ordinary public CLI and corrupt-checkpoint refusal
Existing reaction_transport and shared scalar/cohort identity regression suites
scope_exclusions: Measured calcium-buffer parameters or biological validation
Intercompartment exchange, ER membrane, SERCA, calcium channels or voltage feedback
Open driven chemistry, chemostats, changing volumes or zero initial species amounts
Native BETSE calcium comparison or full BETSE equivalence
Shared ensemble queue adapter, sustained GPU utilization, JUPITER deployment or multi-GPU scaling
